What is a generator and how is yield different from return?

Supplied answer
A generator is a function that uses yield to produce a series of values lazily. return ends the function and
sends back one value, whereas yield pauses the function, sends a value out, and remembers the state
so execution continues from that point on the next call. Generators are memory efficient because they
never build the whole sequence.
